tasks.label: CV: configure product (menuconfig)
tasks.detail: Edit a product's Kconfig options, then save the minimal defconfig back
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && .venv/bin/defconfig --kconfig Kconfig configs/${input:product}_defconfig && .venv/bin/menuconfig Kconfig && .venv/bin/savedefconfig --kconfig Kconfig --out configs/${input:product}_defconfig && .venv/bin/python tools/kconfig2variants.py --all --vscode
